hero.title_line1: This is not just a game.
hero.subtitle: Dive into a space where play is a way to know yourself, understand systems, and co-create reality with others.

home.auth_required_msg: To create a game, please register or sign in first.

features.title: What are these games
features.desc: Not entertainment — a tool. Every game is a structured situation where you think, decide and reflect.
features.card1_desc: You don't observe — you play a role, make decisions and feel the consequences in real time.
features.card2_desc: Conflicting interests, coalitions, negotiations — everything that exists in real teams, but in a safe space.
features.card3_desc: The debrief is the most important part. What happened? Why did you decide that way? What does it say about you?

audience.title: Who are these games for
audience.desc: For those who want more — from themselves, their team, and reality.
audience.card1_desc: Want to know yourself better, test your limits and expand your perception of reality — these games are made for you.
audience.card2_desc: Team-building games or forecasting sessions — when you need to see the future through the lens of play.
audience.card3_desc: A space where ideas are born. Where play becomes a method of thinking, not just entertainment.

how.title: How it works
how.desc: Four steps from invitation to insight.
how.step1_desc: The moderator selects a template or builds a custom scenario for your group.
how.step2_desc: A character with interests, resources, and decisions to make awaits you.
how.step3_desc: Negotiations, votes, unexpected alliances and conflicts.
how.step4_desc: Reflection after the game often changes how you see real life.

legal.privacy_intro_text: Games of Senses respects your privacy. This document describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
legal.data_collection_text: We collect information you provide directly and information created when you use the platform:
legal.data_account: Account: first name, last name, email, password hash
legal.data_games: Games: title, description, game code, participants, date/time, status
legal.data_telegram: Telegram: chat_id to receive game codes and reminders
legal.usage_notifications: Sending notifications about game codes, reminders, and updates
legal.usage_communications: Communicating with you about the platform and your account
legal.third_party_text: We use the following third-party services which may process your information:
legal.service_cloudinary: Profile picture and post image storage
legal.security_text: We use encryption (HTTPS), secure passwords (bcrypt), secure tokens (JWT), and access controls to protect your information. However, no system is 100% secure.
legal.right_delete: Request deletion of your account and data
legal.right_export: Export your data in machine-readable format
legal.retention_text: We retain your information while your account is active. Game recordings are automatically deleted 7 days after game completion.
legal.children_text: Our platform is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.
legal.changes_text: We may change the policy. Significant changes will be notified to you via Telegram or by message in the 'Games of Senses' Telegram group.
legal.contact_text: If you have questions about this policy, please contact us.
legal.terms_acceptance_text: By using the Games of Senses platform, you accept these terms. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the platform.
legal.use_license_text: We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to access and use the platform in accordance with these terms. You may not resell, transfer, modify, or use the platform for commercial purposes without our permission.
legal.platform_desc: Games of Senses is a platform that connects Game Masters (GMs) and players. We do not control game content, the quality of GM services, or financial transactions between participants.
legal.platform_facilitation: We only provide tools for conducting game sessions
legal.platform_no_intermediary: We are not an intermediary in payments between GMs and players
legal.platform_gm_responsibilities: The GM is responsible for game quality and participant conduct
legal.platform_payment_responsibility: Payments and settlements are direct agreements between GM and players
legal.payments_intro: Games of Senses allows GMs to set a price for game participation. However, the platform does not process payments. All financial transactions occur outside the platform.
legal.payments_how_text: The GM can set a price for the game. Participants voluntarily transfer funds to the GM directly (e.g., via bank transfer, PayPal, cryptocurrency). The platform does not participate in these transactions.
legal.payments_gm_responsibility_text: The GM bears full responsibility for price transparency, service quality, service delivery, and dispute resolution with players. The GM ensures that fund collection complies with local laws.
legal.payments_platform_responsibility_text: Games of Senses does not collect, store, or guarantee fulfillment of GM services. The platform terminates service for users who violate these terms.
legal.payments_disputes_text: Disputes regarding payments between GMs and players are handled directly between the parties. The platform does not resolve such disputes. If a GM uses the platform for fraud, the platform suspends their account.
legal.user_responsibilities_text: By using the platform, you agree to:
legal.responsibility_accurate: Provide accurate and complete information during registration
legal.responsibility_content: Not post offensive, illegal, or discriminatory content
legal.responsibility_behavior: Not harass, stalk, or threaten other users
legal.responsibility_compliance: Comply with these terms and platform policies
legal.gm_responsibilities_text: In addition to general user responsibilities, GMs commit to:
legal.gm_responsibility_create: Describe games honestly and in detail
legal.gm_responsibility_price: Set fair prices and be transparent about settlements
legal.gm_responsibility_safe: Ensure a safe environment for all participants
legal.gm_responsibility_participants: Not discriminate against participants based on race, gender, nationality, etc.
legal.conduct_intro: The following is prohibited on the platform:
legal.conduct_harass: Harassment, bullying, or insulting other users
legal.conduct_illegal: Using the platform for illegal activities
legal.conduct_spam: Spam, unsolicited mass mailings, or unwanted content
legal.conduct_malware: Uploading malware or attempting to hack
legal.conduct_interfere: Interfering with platform operation or other users
legal.content_rights_user: You retain ownership of all content you upload (photos, messages, comments).
legal.content_rights_grant: By uploading content, you grant the platform a license to display and distribute it for platform operation.
legal.content_rights_removal: You can delete your content at any time, or we can delete content that violates this agreement.
legal.recordings_text: Game recordings are stored on the platform's servers and archived in Google Drive. Participants have the right to know about recording before participation.
legal.recordings_storage: Recordings are stored for 7 days, then automatically deleted
legal.recordings_deletion: GMs and participants can delete recordings earlier
legal.recordings_consent: All participants must consent to recording before the game
legal.disclaimer_text: The platform is provided 'as is'. We do not guarantee that the platform will be error-free, continuous, or suitable for your needs. We are not responsible for damages arising from platform use.
legal.limitation_text: In no event shall Games of Senses be liable for direct, indirect, special, or consequential damages. Our maximum liability is limited to the amount you paid to the platform (if any).
legal.termination_text: We may terminate your platform access without notice if you violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time.
legal.disputes_text: Disputes are resolved through negotiation. If negotiation is unsuccessful, disputes are resolved in accordance with the laws of Ukraine. You agree to the jurisdiction of the courts of Ukraine to resolve disputes related to the platform.
